cases.sql: WITH input AS (VALUES(8)),written AS (INSERT INTO rule_event(n,unused) SELECT column1,0 FROM input) INSERT INTO rule_output(n) VALUES(7)
cases.query: RESET ROLE; SELECT json_build_object('rows', (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r)) FROM (SELECT n,m,payload FROM rule_output ORDER BY ordinal) r), 'event', (SELECT json_agg(n ORDER BY n) FROM rule_event), 'next', nextval('rule_ticks'))
